svg.title: Rules for AI Trading Agents: an open-source example
svg.desc: A short chat. You ask Claude to check a buy of 235.423197 ECHO/USD. Claude says 1 of your rules is newly outside range: Crypto goes from 0% before to 7.29% after, against your range of 0% to 7%. Cash is 4,332.73, enough for this order. Claude asks whether to place it in your Alpaca paper account, as a market order good until cancelled, and you say yes. An example from the Allocait team. Shared as is. Not an Allocait product. Not made or endorsed by Alpaca or Anthropic. Illustration. Symbols and numbers are made up.
